title: The elicited key naming convention flows through every facade verb: prefixed applies the keyPrefix, flat passes keys through untouched
asA: developer applying platform-cloudflare-kv against a project with either per-domain prefixed keys or a flat key space
iWant: the facade to honour the elicited kv-key-naming-convention answer transparently on every put/get/delete/list call
soThat: domain code writes prefix-free keys under prefixed mode and stays unchanged under flat mode; storage-side keys carry the prefix only under prefixed mode

acceptanceCriteria.description: With kv-key-naming-convention=prefixed and elicited keyPrefix="users/", a facade.put("42", value) writes to storage-side key "users/42"; a facade.get("42") reads the same storage-side key and returns the value; a facade.list({prefix: ""}) returns entries with storage-side keys prefixed by "users/" and the returned records expose the storage-side keys verbatim so domain code sees the full applied namespace.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a facade wired against an in-memory KV driver with elicited kv-key-naming-convention=prefixed and keyPrefix="users/"
acceptanceCriteria.when: facade.put, facade.get and facade.list are called with prefix-free domain keys
acceptanceCriteria.then: storage-side keys carry the "users/" prefix and reads round-trip

acceptanceCriteria.description: With kv-key-naming-convention=flat, the facade passes keys through untouched: a facade.put("users/42", value) writes to storage-side key "users/42" (identical to the input); a facade.get("users/42") reads it back; the facade does NOT apply any additional prefix.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a facade wired against an in-memory KV driver with elicited kv-key-naming-convention=flat
acceptanceCriteria.when: facade.put and facade.get are called with the exact intended storage-side keys
acceptanceCriteria.then: storage-side keys equal the input keys verbatim
